description: Validates Test Genie phase-provider descriptors: descriptor structure, embedded maturity, policy safety, stale-file absence, and live provider-contract conformance.

notApplicableKinds.reason: This provider validates phase descriptors and live validation-provider contracts; the control plane is a target, not a phase-provider scenario.

levels.name: Provider conformance unavailable
levels.description: The target declares itself as a Test Genie phase provider but its descriptor cannot be inspected.

levels.name: Provider descriptor inspectable
levels.description: The target's phase descriptor is readable and its structure can be judged.
exit_criteria: Descriptor, embedded maturity, and policy satisfy the phase descriptor contract.

levels.name: Provider contract governed
levels.description: The descriptor is contract-valid and the live provider honors the shared validation contract.
exit_criteria: Live validation responses are contract-valid with correct identity and metrics.

levels.name: Provider conformance clean
levels.description: Descriptor and live contract checks are clean.

capabilities.label: Provider Descriptor
capabilities.description: Presence, parseability, identity, embedded maturity, policy safety, stale-file absence, and operator docs for .vrooli/test-genie.json.

levels.name: Descriptor missing
levels.description: The target declares provider ownership but has no readable phase descriptor.
levels.capability_summary: Test Genie cannot inspect the target's phase contract.

levels.name: Descriptor readable
levels.description: The descriptor parses and declares a phase.
levels.next_unlock: Descriptor, maturity, and policy satisfy the phase descriptor contract.

levels.name: Descriptor contract-valid
levels.description: Descriptor structure, embedded maturity, identity, and policy are valid with no stale maturity file.
levels.capability_summary: The phase can be registered from this descriptor.
levels.next_unlock: Operator docs and autofix declarations are complete.

capabilities.label: Provider Contract
capabilities.description: Live ScenarioValidationService conformance: reachability, contract validity, assessment identity, execution metrics, and autofix declaration coverage.

levels.name: Contract unproven
levels.description: The provider's live validation contract has not been proven.
levels.capability_summary: Provider contract conformance cannot be measured.
levels.next_unlock: A reachable provider serving contract-valid validation responses.

levels.name: Contract inspectable
levels.description: The provider responds but violates part of the shared validation contract.
levels.capability_summary: Test Genie can probe the provider contract.
levels.next_unlock: Contract-valid responses with correct identity and metrics.

levels.name: Contract clean
levels.description: Live responses are contract-valid with correct identity, execution metrics, and fix-class declarations.

PROVIDER_DESCRIPTOR_MISSING.reason: Whether a scenario should be a Test Genie phase provider is an ownership decision.

PROVIDER_DESCRIPTOR_INVALID.reason: Descriptor repair depends on the provider's intended phase semantics.

PROVIDER_IDENTITY_MISMATCH.reason: Identity mismatches signal a moved or copied descriptor that the owner must reconcile.

PROVIDER_MATURITY_INVALID.reason: Maturity ladders encode provider judgment that cannot be synthesized mechanically.

PROVIDER_STALE_MATURITY_FILE.reason: Deleting the retired maturity.json requires confirming the descriptor block is the migrated source of truth.

PROVIDER_DURABLE_CONTRACT_INVALID.reason: A declared durable-run lifecycle that does not behave is a provider implementation defect its owner must resolve.

PROVIDER_DECLARED_KINDS_UNSUPPORTED.reason: Reconciling a descriptor's target kinds with the running binary's is an owner decision about which one is correct.

PROVIDER_SUBJECT_OUTSIDE_DECLARED_KINDS.reason: A finding attributed to an undeclared target kind means either the subject or the declaration is wrong; only the provider owner knows which.

PROVIDER_CAPABILITY_TARGET_COVERAGE_GAP.reason: A capability that claims a target kind no finding can reach is unfalsifiable; removing the claim or adding the finding is a design choice.

PROVIDER_TARGET_GLOB_UNRESOLVABLE.reason: A kind that enumerates zero targets reads identically to a kind nobody adopted; fixing the roots or dropping the kind needs owner judgment.

PROVIDER_EXECUTION_RUNNER_MISSING.reason: Registering a language runner for an executable target kind is an implementation decision, not a mechanical edit.

PROVIDER_RUNNING_SPEC_VERSION_STALE.reason: A stale provider binary must be rebuilt and restarted by its operator; the validator can only report the drift.

PROVIDER_POLICY_UNSAFE.reason: Policy combinations trade off run safety and coverage; the provider owner must choose.

PROVIDER_DOCS_MISSING.reason: Phase documentation must explain provider-specific semantics only the owner knows.

PROVIDER_DOCS_SKELETON_INCOMPLETE.reason: The remediation doc must follow the Phase Capability Contract skeleton so run doc-search topics resolve to the right section.

PROVIDER_NORTH_STAR_MISSING.reason: The ladder's top rung must state a first-class North Star aspiration only the provider owner can author.

PROVIDER_LADDER_INCOMPLETE.reason: Every ladder rung needs entry/exit gates and a next_unlock so the standing can direct the next move.

PROVIDER_RUNG_UNGATED.reason: Every declared ladder transition needs a real provider finding on the destination rung; Test Genie warns until the catalog descriptor fleet is remediated.

PROVIDER_AUTOFIX_DECLARATION_INCOMPLETE.reason: Fix-class declarations encode per-finding safety judgment.

PROVIDER_UNREACHABLE.reason: Reachability is an environmental signal fixed by starting the provider, not a descriptor defect.

PROVIDER_CONTRACT_INVALID.reason: Contract violations require provider-side response construction fixes.

PROVIDER_CONTRACT_IDENTITY_MISMATCH.reason: Identity stamping is provider-side response logic.

PROVIDER_METRICS_MISSING.reason: Metrics adoption requires wiring the shared collector through the provider's handler.

PROVIDER_DETERMINISM_UNDECLARED.reason: Cache eligibility is a provider ownership decision and must not be inferred from timing or a partial input scan.

determinism.reason: Provider conformance calls each provider's live Connect endpoint to read its descriptor, build identity, and metrics adoption. The verdict describes the running provider fleet, so it cannot be derived from a file digest.
